name: ddrm-viewer
description: Render an owned, protected NON-MEDIA asset (image, PDF, text/code, 3D) from a scoped decrypt session. Satisfies the elastos.viewer/document@1 interface; consumes only the scoped decrypted object bytes over a session handle, never the CEK, IV, or release receipt.
author: elastos

interfaces.description: Render protected non-media objects (image, PDF, text/code, 3D) from a scoped decrypt session

methods.description: Open a protected non-media asset via a scoped decrypt session, consuming only decrypted object bytes
